name: Yoga school in Seoul
reason: No usable school found in three searches. The Flow Room (theflowroomyoga.com, Itaewon, English-led) is a Wix site, so its photos sit on static.wixstatic.com, which refuses our robots.txt request; no usable photo, and no teacher training was confirmed. Magic Pond International Yoga School and the Gangnam Ashtanga Yoga Studio appeared only in directory and magazine listings, with no own website found. A Korean-language search turned up no Seoul school's own site. Directories (10mag, Yoga Alliance, BookRetreats) were not used as sources.
